enabled.description: Enable deployment of a Toil WES server in the cluster.

replicaCount.description: Number of Toil WES replicas to run.

celery.description: Optional Celery-based execution mode for Toil WES. When enabled, the WES server sends workflow runs to Celery workers through a broker instead of executing them in-process.

enabled.description: Enable Celery-backed workflow execution for Toil WES. Requires shared storage accessible by both server and workers.

replicaCount.description: Number of Celery worker replicas to run for Toil WES.

brokerUrl.description: External Celery broker URL; mutually exclusive with brokerSecret.name.

resultBackend.description: Celery result backend used by Toil WES to query task liveness/status. Defaults to rpc:// so the broker is also used for result metadata.

workerLogLevel.description: Celery worker log level (for example: INFO, DEBUG, WARNING).

awsRegion.description: AWS region value required by aws:<region>:<prefix> locator syntax (can be synthetic when using S3-compatible backends).

batchSystem.description: Toil batch system backend (for example: kubernetes, singleMachine, mesos, slurm).

workDir.description: Working directory used by the Toil WES server.

stateStore.description: Path to the Toil WES state store directory.

sharedStorage.description: Shared RWX storage used by the Toil WES server and Celery workers. Required when Celery mode is enabled so both pods see the same workDir and stateStore.

enabled.description: Mount shared storage for Toil WES.

create.description: Create a dedicated PVC for Toil WES shared storage. If false, existingClaim must be set.

existingClaim.description: Existing PVC name to use for Toil WES shared storage.

mountPath.description: Mount path for shared storage in the server and Celery worker containers. Should match the parent directory of workDir and stateStore.

accessMode.description: PVC access mode for shared storage (typically ReadWriteMany for multiple pods).

size.description: Requested PVC size for shared storage.

storageClass.description: StorageClass for the shared PVC. Empty string uses the cluster default.

privileged.description: Enable privileged mode for Kubernetes worker pods launched by Toil (mapped to --kubernetesPrivileged and TOIL_KUBERNETES_PRIVILEGED).

hostPath.description: Explicit hostPath passed to Toil workers through TOIL_KUBERNETES_HOST_PATH. Takes precedence over nfsMount.nodeMountPath.

nfsMount.description: Node-level NFS/EFS mount configuration used to provide a hostPath for Toil workers.

enabled.description: Enable the DaemonSet that mounts the NFS/EFS share on each Kubernetes node.

server.description: NFS server hostname/IP or EFS DNS endpoint.

path.description: Exported NFS path to mount from the server.

nodeMountPath.description: Path where the share is mounted on each Kubernetes node. Used as TOIL_KUBERNETES_HOST_PATH when hostPath is empty.

mountOptions.description: NFS mount options used by the node-level mount DaemonSet and the static NFS PV.

image.description: Container image used by the node-level NFS mount DaemonSet.

repository.description: Image repository for the node-level mount helper.

tag.description: Image tag for the node-level mount helper.

pullPolicy.description: Image pull policy for the node-level mount helper.

enable_cache.description: Enable shared Singularity/Apptainer cache environment variables for Toil workers.

s3.description: S3-compatible endpoint configuration used by Toil AWS job store (e.g., MinIO/Ceph).

env.description: Additional environment variables for the Toil WES container.

resolverOptions.description: DNS resolver options propagated to Toil workers via RES_OPTIONS (for example: ndots:1).

resources.description: Default and maximum resource values used by Toil jobs.

defaultMemory.description: Default memory allocated to jobs when not explicitly set (for example: 8Gi).

defaultDisk.description: Default disk allocated to jobs when not explicitly set (for example: 16Gi).

maxMemory.description: Optional maximum memory allowed for jobs. Empty string means no explicit cap.

maxDisk.description: Optional maximum disk allowed for jobs. Empty string means no explicit cap.
